        buf.append((doc_id, text))
        if len(buf) == chunk:
            yield _process_chunk(buf)
            buf = []
    if buf:
        yield _process_chunk(buf)


def _process_chunk(docs):

    postings = []

        for word, pos in _tokenize(text):
            term_positions[word].append(pos)
        for term, positions in term_positions.items():
            postings.append((term, doc_id, positions))

        elif text[i] == ')':

        elif text[i] == '+':

        elif text[i] == '-':
            tokens.append('-')
            i += 1
        elif text[i] == '*':

                tokens.append('**')
                i += 2
            else:
                tokens.append('*')
                i += 1
        elif text[i] == '/':
            if i + 1 < n and text[i+1] == '/':
                tokens.append('//')
                i += 2
            else:

        elif text[i].isdigit():

            tokens.append(int(text[i:j]))
